cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
# version.txt is bumped by release-please; do not edit it by hand.
file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/version.txt" LIBOBD2_VERSION LIMIT_COUNT 1)
project(OBD2 VERSION ${LIBOBD2_VERSION} LANGUAGES C)

# --- FreeRTOS Configuration Setup ---
# This MUST be defined before adding the FreeRTOS subdirectory
option(SPT_FREERTOS "Support for FreeRTOS" ON)
option(SPT_TRACING  "Support for tracing" OFF)
option(LIBOBD2_USE_AMALGAMATION "Build the OBD2 library from the generated single header (dist/libobd2.h)" OFF)

if(SPT_FREERTOS STREQUAL ON)
    message("FreeRTOS= ON")
else()
    message("FreeRTOS= OFF")
endif()
if(SPT_TRACING STREQUAL ON)
    message("Tracing= ON")

    if("${PLATFORM}" STREQUAL "")
        message(SEND_ERROR "Platform cannot be empty")
    else()
        message("Platform= ${PLATFORM}")
    endif()
else()
    message("Tracing= OFF")
endif()

if(SPT_FREERTOS STREQUAL ON)
    add_library(freertos_config INTERFACE)

    target_include_directories(freertos_config SYSTEM
        INTERFACE
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ports/stm32f4/config #TODO: change stm32f4 with a variable
    )

    target_compile_definitions(freertos_config
        INTERFACE
        projCOVERAGE_TEST=0
    )

    # Set FreeRTOS build variables
    set(FREERTOS_PORT "GCC_ARM_CM4F" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    set(FREERTOS_HEAP "4" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

    # Add the FreeRTOS Kernel
    add_subdirectory(
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/examples/libs/FreeRTOS-Kernel
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/FreeRTOS-Kernel
    )

    # Explicitly link the config to the kernel targets
    # The error happens in the 'port' target specifically
    target_link_libraries(freertos_kernel PUBLIC freertos_config)
    target_link_libraries(freertos_kernel_port PUBLIC freertos_config)
endif()

if(SPT_TRACING STREQUAL ON)
    file(GLOB SOURCES
        "./ports/${PLATFORM}/trace.c"
    )
endif()

file(GLOB SOURCES
    "./src/app/src/*.c"
    "./src/datalink/common/*.c"
    "./src/datalink/specific/iso9141/*.c"
    "./src/datalink/specific/kwp2000/*.c"
    "./src/utils/common/*.c"
    "./src/data_link/kwp/*.c"
)

# --- Single header (stb-style dist/libobd2.h, see scripts/amalgamate.py) ---
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(LIBOBD2_SINGLE_HEADER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dist/libobd2.h)

if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
    file(GLOB AMALGAMATION_HEADERS
        "./include/*.h"
        "./src/app/inc/*.h"
        "./src/datalink/common/*.h"
        "./src/datalink/specific/iso9141/*.h"
        "./src/datalink/specific/kwp2000/*.h"
        "./src/utils/common/*.h"
    )

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${LIBOBD2_SINGLE_HEADER}
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/amalgamate.py
                -o ${LIBOBD2_SINGLE_HEADER} --version ${PROJECT_VERSION}
        DEPENDS
            ${SOURCES}
            ${AMALGAMATION_HEADERS}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/amalgamate.py
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        COMMENT "Generating single header ${LIBOBD2_SINGLE_HEADER}"
        VERBATIM
    )
    add_custom_target(amalgamate DEPENDS ${LIBOBD2_SINGLE_HEADER})
elseif(LIBOBD2_USE_AMALGAMATION)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "LIBOBD2_USE_AMALGAMATION needs a Python 3 interpreter")
else()
    message(STATUS "Python 3 not found: the amalgamate target is not available")
endif()

if(LIBOBD2_USE_AMALGAMATION)
    message("Amalgamation= ON")
    # One TU with the whole implementation. It sits next to the generated header,
    # so its #include "libobd2.h" picks dist/libobd2.h before src/app/inc/libobd2.h.
    set(LIBOBD2_IMPL_SOURCE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dist/libobd2_impl.c)
    if(NOT EXISTS ${LIBOBD2_IMPL_SOURCE})
        file(WRITE ${LIBOBD2_IMPL_SOURCE}
            "/* Generated by CMakeLists.txt (LIBOBD2_USE_AMALGAMATION) */\n"
            "#define LIBOBD2_IMPLEMENTATION\n"
            "#include \"libobd2.h\"\n"
        )
    endif()
    add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} ${LIBOBD2_IMPL_SOURCE})
    add_dependencies(${PROJECT_NAME} amalgamate)
else()
    add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} ${SOURCES})
endif()

if(SPT_FREERTOS STREQUAL ON)
    target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME}
        PRIVATE
        SPT_FREERTOS
    )
endif()
if(SPT_TRACING STREQUAL ON)
    target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME}
        PRIVATE
        SPT_TRACING
    )
endif()
if(LOGGING STREQUAL "ON")
    target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME}
        PRIVATE
        LOGGING
    )
endif()

if(SPT_FREERTOS STREQUAL ON)
    target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME}
        PUBLIC
        ./examples/libs/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/GCC/ARM_CM4F/
        ./examples/libs/FreeRTOS-Kernel/include/
    )

    target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME}
        PUBLIC
        freertos_config
        freertos_kernel
    )
endif()

if(SPT_TRACING STREQUAL ON)
    target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME}
        PUBLIC
        ./ports/${PLATFORM}/
    )
endif()

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME}
    PUBLIC
    ./include/
    ./src/datalink/common
    ./src/datalink/specific/iso9141/
    ./src/datalink/specific/kwp2000/
    ./src/utils/common/
    ./src/app/inc/
)

target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    -save-temps=obj
)
